description: Search AI use cases with hybrid full-text and vector ranking. Supports provider, industry, geography, technology, customer, partner, and boolean case-type filters. Filters work without a query, for example customer_name alone lists that company's deployments.

cloud_provider.description: Microsoft, AWS, GCP, or comma-separated values.

country.description: Filter by country code, for example US or GB.

customer_name.description: Filter by the company adopting AI.

limit.description: Maximum results requested. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

name: hybrid_search_usecases
title: Search AI deployments with filters
